findings.summary: One `staticScalarValue` in number-intrinsics folds a generation-known number, boolean or string for both the async argument pin and data-lowering's constant initializer, instead of two hand-written three-way ladders.
`readsNativeStorage` and `snapshotReadCpp` in the value model replace the inline `nativeLvalue || identifier` predicate repeated in binding-scopes, declarations and native-functions.

`BindingScopes.retainedValue` replaces the hand-rolled const-home declarations of the scene-node vector owner, camera vector owner, call argument, transform target and indexed-tuple receiver; a stable const binding is reused rather than copied again.
`registerNativeConstBinding` takes the binding's C++ type, so the loop element and property owner register in one call instead of pairing it with `registerNativeBindingType`.
`pinValueToTemporary` gains an `exclusive` option that registers the pinned local as a native temporary, replacing the shared-result caller's own registration.

Mesh streams read a held typed array through one `heldTypedArrayValue` service in compiler.ts, scoped to name, member and element reads so the probe no longer records browser-erasure counts for a constructed array.
`RecordRepresentation.snapshot` owns the scalar-versus-`snapshot_value` spelling the record lowerer's owned reads, for-of ranges and element bindings share.

`lazyStaticAccessor` in cpp-literals emits the construct-on-first-use accessor for realm state and the node-particle `state()`, carrying the throwing-initializer rationale in source instead of an emitted comment.

The physics-debug catalog is constant data compared in place -- a span view per descriptor and one constexpr table -- instead of one guarded static and one comparison per shape. The first form, a function-local table of allocated descriptors, overflowed scene41's stack in the sweep: its 650,000 initializer lanes were materialized in one full-expression.
js_data.hpp's four `present` overloads fold into one forwarding template over Nullable and std::optional, sharing a `[[noreturn]]` `throw_nullish_access` with `Nullable::require_owned`.
The weighted-animation runtime's `node._matrix` expression hook is deleted: the bool binding already spells the same read.
The numeric lowerer's list alias binds by reference only while the source's storage is never reassigned in the function; a reseated source now copies, as JavaScript keeps the old list.
`platformEvent` is renamed `borrowedEvent` now that it covers read-only custom-event parameters, and the closure-environment value-initialization flag is computed once.
Trim the navigation-plan and floating-origin comments to one line, correct the GPU timer's capacity wording, and explain the named texel local in pal_texture_texels.hpp.
Unify `retainedValue`, `pinValueToTemporary` and `bindDataTuple` into one binding service.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: the three are different contracts -- a const retained home, an owning pin that folds constants and may transfer, and a tuple home indexed per lane -- and one service would need mode flags for each.

findings.summary: Mark for-of loop elements immutable in `isImmutableVariable` instead of defining the loop name directly on the element.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: markImmutableNativeStorage reads isImmutableVariable for every binding, so widening it would change which storage every loop body treats as immutable; defining the loop name on the element changes only handle loops.

findings.summary: Derive `bbl::js::present` from the binding machinery instead of spelling it at each record lowerer's presence-guarded read.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: presence is established by the pinned body's own control flow, which only the record lowerers read; the binding layer carries no presence facts to derive it from.

findings.summary: Alias record-lowerer locals initialized from storage instead of snapshotting them.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: those locals were already copy-initialized before this change and only the spelling became explicit; aliasing them is a behaviour change across the pinned bodies that nothing here measures.

findings.summary: Give the node-particle snapshot accessor and the plain `state()` accessor one name.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: the lowered particle bodies take `state` as a local parameter name, so the snapshot accessor keeps its own name to avoid shadowing it.

findings.summary: Add an rvalue `Nullable` overload of `snapshot_value` that moves instead of copying.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: the overload copies one held element, and no profile shows a generated site where that copy costs anything.

findings.summary: Hoist `bbl::js::present(world.fo)` out of the floating-origin loops.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: the call is an inlined presence check per loop, and no frame-time cost has been measured that hoisting would recover.

findings.summary: Route `indexed_array` and `materializeStaticNativeValue` through `retainedValue` too.
findings.blockedBy: Declined: clang-tidy flags neither, and each keeps a contract retainedValue does not model -- a mutable indexed home and a static value materialized once.

findings.summary: Delete `GltfPbrValue`'s destructor instead of lowering the material conditional as a lambda.
findings.blockedBy: Declined after a probe: removing the destructor left the NewDeleteLeaks report in place; the conditional selecting a class prvalue was the trigger, and the lambda form matches the lowerer's own &&, || and ?? lowering.
